items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 30.01.2026 (Friday). This is a private-law payment (company invoice, not an authority letter), so the day of the invoice itself is not counted (§187 Abs. 1 BGB); the one-month period starts 31.01.2026. One month later lands on 28.02.2026 (§188 Abs. 3 BGB, shorter month), which is a Saturday. Under §193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 02.03.2026.
